g.text: Preciazo - Design-Level Event Storming: Catalog and Pricing
AV2 Design Proposal - US13, US15-US17, US19, US23, US25
Current selling price and last update
Complete totals and explicit missing products
Price per kg / litre when content is known
Curated compatible products; no list mutation
A positive selling price and a snapshot are saved atomically.
Unavailable items are missing items, never zero-cost products.
Comparisons are queries: no comparison command or persisted event.
A substitute suggestion does not replace a Shopping Planning item.
Define price freshness and reference-data refresh guarantees.
Store reference provisioning and inventory/catalog coordination are pending.
No ACL or cross-context domain dependency is introduced.
